<STBG 5,0><BGM 0,0,504><MWT 5><COL FEEB4EFF>At <COL FEEB4EFF>Roselle Stream</COL>, gazing at an <COL FEEB4EFF>Arzuros</COL>,
the glare dazzled my eyes.

<MWT 4><COL FEEB4EFF>I looked up, thinking it was the <COL FEEB4EFF>sun</COL>,
but it was the sun as always.

<MWT 4>But something caught the corner of my eye:
a second sun floating upon the ground...
